title: Riding the Train to Ella: A Journey Through the Clouds
description: Experience the world's most scenic train ride and explore the lush green hills of Ella.
author: Tourvir Team
content: The train journey from Kandy or Nuwara Eliya to Ella is often described as one of the most beautiful in the world. As you chug through misty mountains and endless tea estates, the views are simply breathtaking. Once in Ella, hike up Little Adam's Peak for panoramic views, visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, and enjoy a warm cup of world-renowned Ceylon tea in the cool highland climate.
